items.title: Can Eli Lilly (LLY) Stay Undervalued If Growth Keeps Delivering?
items.summary: Eli Lilly stock trades around US$1,180 per share after a very strong five year run. Current checks suggest the intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model still sits meaningfully above that price, while the market multiples look closer to fair. Eli Lilly has delivered a 361.1% total return over the past five years, which sets a high bar for any further upside from here. items.title: Eli Lilly and Company (LLY)’s Weight-Loss Pill Just Won Its First Race in Europe. Novo Nordisk A/S (NVO) Still Has a Head Start
